en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Abu Najran, from Safwan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassa Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Pray the two Rak’at of Al-Fajr in the carriage’.
en.sarwar: 11. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Sulayman from Sa’d ibn Sa’d from Muqatil ibn Muqatil from abu al-Harith who has said the following: “I once asked him (Imam al-Rida’), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the four Rak‘at after al-Maghrib on a journey, because camel man is in hurry and I am not able to perform on the ground. Can I perform Salah (prayer) in the carriage on the camel’s back?
He (the Imam) said, ‘Yes, you can perform it in the carriage.’”
